spans.s:
1. शमि, इस्, f. a legume, pod; the Śamī tree [cf.
शमी].
—शमि-रोह, अस्, m. ‘ascending the Śamī
tree,’ an epithet of Śiva.

शमी, f. (sometimes shortened into शमि, q. v.),
a rite, sacrificial rite (Ved., according to Naigh.

II.
1

. and Sāy. = कर्म); a legume, pod; the Śamī
tree, Acacia Suma (possessing a very tough and hard
wood supposed to contain fire, [cf. Manu
VIII. 247

,
Raghu-vaṃśa
III. 9

]; it was employed to kindle
the sacred fire by rubbing two dried pieces together,
and a legend relates that Purū-ravas generated pri-
meval fire by the friction of two branches of the Śamī
and Aśvattha trees); the shrub Serratula Anthel-
mintica (= वागुजी).
—शमी-गर्भ, अस्, m. ‘having
the Śamī tree as its place of origin, produced from
the Śamī tree,’ epithet of Agni or fire; a Brāhman
or man of the sacerdotal class.
—शमी-धान्य, अम्,
n. ‘pod-grain’ any pulse or grain growing in pods.
—शमी-पत्त्री, f. ‘having Śamī leaves,’ a kind of
sensitive plant, Mimosa Pudica.
—शमी-मन्दार-
माहात्म्य, अम्, n. ‘glorification of the Śamī and
Mandāra trees,’ N. of the thirty-seventh chapter of
the Krīḍā-khaṇḍa of the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa.

समि 1. सम्-इ (see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P. -एति,
-एतुम्, to go or come together, meet together,
assemble; to meet or be united with (with acc. or
inst. or dat.); to meet any one (inst.) in hostile
encounter; to come together or be united sexually;
to be joined or united together (generally); to go
or come to, arrive at, approach, visit, enter, reach,
attain; to enter upon, commence; to lead to; to
agree with, harmonize with (with inst.): Pass. -ईयते,
to be united; to be resorted to or frequented by; to
be agreed upon: Intens., Ved. -ईयते, to go repeat-
edly, traverse frequently; to present one's self, be
manifested.

समि 2. समि, apparently an old loc. con-
nected with 2. सम्. See सम्य्-अञ्च्.

सम्मि सम्-मि (see rt. 1. मि), cl. 5. P. A. -मि-
नोति, -मिनुते, &c., Ved. to fasten at the same time,
fasten together, fix, erect.

सामि सामि, ind. (said to be a form of the
old inst. साम्या of साम्य; cf. आदि for आद्य), half
(often used in comp. like the English सेमि-; cf.
अ-सामि); blamably; [cf. Gr. ἡμι-, ἥμι-συ-ς; Lat.
semi-, semi-s; Old Germ. sâmi- in sâmi-quek,
‘half-alive;’ Angl. Sax. sâm- in sâm-boren, ‘half-
born, abortive,’ sâm-worht; Eng. semi-.]
—सामि-
कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made half, halved, divided.
—सा-
मि-पीत, अस्, आ, अम्, half-drunk.
—सामि-भुक्त, अस्,
आ, अम्, half-eaten, semi-devoured.

शमित, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. शान्त], appeased, al-
layed, calmed, stilled, tranquillized, pacified, calm,
quiet, tranquil, sedate; alleviated, relieved, cured;
tempered, moderated; relaxed, intermitted.
—श-
मित-रुचि, इस्, इस्, इ, whose lustre is moderated or
dimmed.
—शमितायाम (˚त-आय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having the length diminished.

सम्-इत, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, met; col-
lected, assembled; united with, conjoined, connected;
coming into contact, contiguous, parallel; promised,
agreed, assented to; finished, completed.

समिता समिता, f. [cf. समीद], wheat-flour;
[cf. Gr. σεμίδαλις; Lat. simila, similago.]

सम्-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, measured out, measured,
meted; of the same measure, of equal measure or
extent, commensurate, conformable, corresponding,
equal, same, like, resembling, similar, as large as, as
long as (e. g. तुलया स्˚, equal in weight; समरे स्˚,
equal in battle; पाप-स्˚, equal in crime; नगर-स्˚,
as large as a city; योजनायुत-स्˚, ten thousand
Yojanas long); reaching to (e. g. ललाट-स्˚, reaching
to the forehead); equalized, adapted; furnished or
provided with.
सम्मित सम्-मित. See under 1. सम्-मा.
शमितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = शमनीय above.

शमितृ, ता, m., Ved. ‘a settler, silencer,’ a killer,
slaughterer (of a sacrificial victim).

शमित्वा, ind. having become tranquillized or
calmed.

शमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, calm, tranquil, appeased, tran-
quillized, pacific; (ई), m., N. of a son of Śūra.
शमिर, अस्, m. a small variety of the Śamī tree.
शमीर, अस्, m. = शमिर above.

समिर सम्-इर, अस्, m. = सम्-ईर, wind,
air, (see सम्-ईर्.)

सम्-ईर, अस्, m. air, wind; the Samī tree; (आस्),
m. pl., N. of a people.

शमिष्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, about to appease
or tranquillize.

शमीक, अस्, m., N. of a Muni (son of Śūra and
brother of Vasu-deva).

समिक समिक, अम्, n. (see समीक), a pike,
javelin, dart.

समीक समीक, अम्, n. (perhaps connected
with सम्य्-अञ्च्), war, battle, (in Naigh.
II. 17

शामित्र, अम्, n. a sacrificial vessel; a hearth or
place (for cooking a sacrificial animal); a deadly
blow; sacrificing; tying up cattle for sacrifice, &c.

समित्र स-मित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, attended by a
friend, along with a friend.
शामील, अम्, n. ashes (Pāṇ.
षामिल षामिल, N. of a place.
शामीली, f. a chaplet, garland.
सम्-इष्ट. See s. v.

समिष्ट सम्-इष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. सं-यज्),
sacrificed together, sacrificed.

1. समीय, Nom. A. समीयते, &c., to be treated
equally or in the same manner as (with inst.).

2. समीय, अस्, आ, अम्, similar, like, of like
origin.
समीय समीय, &c. See p. 1067.

1. समीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being treated in the
same manner as. (For 2. see under 1. सम्-इ.)

2. सम्-ईयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being come together,
being united with; being treated equally, (in this
sense probably for 1. समीयमान, see p. 1067.

सम्-ईप्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished for, longed for,
desired.

सम्-इत्, त्, f. conflict, war, battle.
—समित्-पाणि,
इस्, m., N. of a pupil of Śaṅkarācārya.

1. सम्-इति, इस्, f. coming together, meeting, assem-
bling, union, association; Association or Society (per-
sonified as a daughter of Prajā-pati); an assembly,
[]
company; encounter, hostile meeting, war, battle,
(enumerated among the सङ्ग्राम-नामानि in
Naigh.
II. 17

); sameness, likeness, equality, (in
this and the following sense probably to be con-
nected with 1. सम); moderation, (एषण-स-
मिति, moderation in desires); one of the five Jaina
rules of life, irreproachable conduct as an ascetic [cf.
भाषा-स्˚].
—समितिञ्-जय, अस्, आ, अम्, conquering
or eminent in an assembly.
—समिति-शोभन, अस्,
आ, अम्, conspicuous in fight or battle.

समिति 2. सम्-इति, ind. a sacred verse be-
ginning with सम्.

सम्-मिति, इस्, f. measuring out, measuring, com-
paring.

सम्-इथ, अस्, अम्, m. n. war, battle (= सङ्-
ग्राम, Naigh.
II. 17

); fire; offering oblations
with fire.

सम्-ईयिवस्, आन्, -युषी, अत्, one who has met or
encountered; one who has gone to or arrived at
or resorted to; one who has attained.
समीयिवस् सम्-ईयिवस्. See col. 1.

समिङ्ग् सम्-इङ्ग्, Caus. -इङ्गयति, -यितुम्,
Ved. to cause to move or throb, agitate, shake about.

समिनक्ष् सम्-इनक्ष् (see इनक्ष्), -इनक्-
षति, Ved. to wish to obtain, strive to reach, be
desirous of.

समिन्ध् सम्-इन्ध्, cl. 7. A. -इन्द्धे or
-इन्धे, &c., to light up, kindle, ignite; to glorify;
to kindle (figuratively), inflame, excite; to take
fire: Pass. -इध्यते, to be kindled, take fire, break
out into flame.

सम्-इद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted up, kindled, ignited,
set alight, set on fire.
—समिद्ध-दर्प, अस्, आ,
अम्, inflamed with pride.
—समिद्ध-शरण, अस्,
आ, अम्, (a town &c.) which has its houses set on
fire.
—समिद्ध-होम, अस्, आ, अम्, having the
oblation kindled.
—समिद्धार्चिस् (˚ध-अर्˚), इस्,
n. a blazing flame.

सम्-इध्, त्, f. fuel, wood, a log of wood, fire-
wood, grass &c. employed as fuel, (seven Samidhs,
or sometimes three times seven, are mentioned, as
well as seven Yonis, seven flames, &c.); a division
of a stanza, (Ved., Sāy. = पाद.)
—समिद्-आधान,
अम्, n. the placing on of wood or fuel (for the obla-
tion to fire).
—समिद्-धोम, अस्, m. (i. e. समिध्-
होम), an oblation of fuel (to fire).
—समिद्-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, having fuel, supplied with fuel.
सम्-इध, अस्, m. fire.

सम्-इधान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. kindled, lighted
(= सम्-इध्यमान).
1. सम्-इध्य, ind. having kindled.

2. समिध्य, Nom. P. समिध्यति, &c., to wish
for fuel.

सम्-इध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being kindled or
ignited.

सम्-इन्धन, अम्, n. the act of kindling; fuel,
fire-wood; (अस्), m. a proper N.

सम्-इन्धान, अस्, आ, अम्, kindling, inflaming;
augmenting, prospering.

समिन्व् सम्-इन्व्, cl. 6. P. -इन्वति, -इन्वितुम्,
Ved. to impart, bestow; to spread through, (Sāy.
समिन्वतु = व्याप्नोतु = प्रापयतु, Ṛg-veda
); to restore.

समीकरण समी-करण, समी-कृ, &c. See
p. 1067, col. 1.

समीक्ष् सम्-ईक्ष्, cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षि-
तुम्, to look at or inspect thoroughly, investigate
closely, view, perceive, see; to look about for, look
around; search for; to look towards, look to; to
consider well, inquire into, investigate, examine,
contemplate, reflect upon: Caus. P. A. -ईक्षयति,
-ते, -यितुम्, to cause to look at or perceive.

सम्मिक्ष् सम्-मिक्ष् or सम्-मिमिक्ष् (by
some regarded as a Desid. form of सम्-मिह्, see
मिक्ष्, p. 777), -मिमिक्षति, &c., to mix together,
mingle.

सम्-ईक्ष, अम्, n. complete investigation; the
Sāṅkhya system of philosophy; (आ), f. thorough or
close inspection; looking well at, consideration, (अ-
समीक्षम्, inconsiderately); investigation, search;
the Mīmāṃsā system of philosophy or any work
examining Vedic ritual and explaining the modes of
sacrifice; understanding, intellect; effort; essential
nature or truth (= तत्त्व, q. v.); any essential princi-
ple (according to the Sāṅkhya system of philosophy).

सम्-ईक्षण, अम्, n. the act of looking at or
inspecting thoroughly; looking about for, search,
close investigation.

सम्-ईक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at or con-
sidering attentively.

सम्-ईक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, well looked at; per-
ceived, considered, investigated.

1. सम्-ईक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at or
considered; to be investigated (in phil.).

2. सम्-ईक्ष्य, ind. having well looked at or
considered, having reflected.
—समीक्ष्य-कारिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, acting after due deliberation.

सम्-ईक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being looked at
or well considered.

समीच समीच, अस्, m. (fr. सम्य्-अञ्च्), the
ocean; (ई), f. a female deer, doe; praise, eulogium.
समीचक, अस्, m. sexual union, copulation.
समीचीन. See under सम्य्-अञ्च्.

समीचीन, अस्, आ, अम्, tending in a common
direction, going with or in company with, agreeing
with, concordant, consistent, convenient, fit, proper,
correct, true, just, right; (अम्), n. propriety, fitness,
truth.

समीद समीद, अस्, m. fine wheat-flour;
[cf. समिता.]

समीन समीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. समा), yearly,
annual, relating to a year; hired for a year; after a
year, a year hence.
समीनिका, f. a cow calving every year.

समीप समीप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. सम्-आप्), near,
contiguous, proximate, adjacent, close by, at hand;
(अम्), n. proximity, vicinity; (ए), ind. in the
vicinity, in the presence of, towards.
—समीप-ग,
अस्, आ, अम्, going near.
—समीप-ज, अस्, आ, अम्,
produced near, growing near.
—समीप-तस्, ind. in
the vicinity of, in the presence of, near, before.
—समीप-ता, f. or समीप-त्व, अम्, n. nearness,
contiguity, proximity.
—समीप-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
or समीप-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being or situated near,
living near, adjoining, neighbouring.
—समीपोप-
गत (˚प-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, approached near.
समीभू समी-भू, &c. See p. 1067, col. 1.

समीर् सम्-ईर्, Caus. P. A. -ईरयति, -ते,
-यितुम्, to cause to move about, agitate; to move,
stir up, excite, rouse; to lift up, raise up, revive; to
send forth, emit, utter (a sound &c.); to throw,
cast; to bring about, accomplish; to confer, bestow,
endow with.

सम्-ईरण, अस्, m. breeze, wind, air; the breath;
a traveller; the plant Maruvaka; (अम्), n. the act
of sending forth or emitting, throwing.
—समीरण-
[]
सहाय, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied by the wind,
fanned by the breeze (as a forest fire).

सम्-ईरित, अस्, आ, अम्, stirred, moved, roused,
sent forth, emitted, uttered; cast, tossed, thrown.

सम्-ईर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, moved about, moved, &c.;
[cf. सम्-ऋ.]

सम्-ईर्ण, referred to सम्-ॠ by Scholiast on
Pāṇ.

समीष् सम्-ईष्, cl. 1. A. -ईषते, Ved. to
become extended or lengthened out.

सम्-ईषित, अस्, आ, अम्, extended, stretched out,
lengthened.

समीह् सम्-ईह्, cl. 1. A. -ईहते, -ईहितुम्, to
strive after (with acc.), endeavour to gain, long after,
desire to accomplish, wish for, desire, hope for.

सम्मिह् सम्-मिह्, apparently cl. 3. A. (see
Ṛg-veda 1. 48, 16, where the form मिमिक्ष्व
occurs), Ved. to sprinkle with, shower down upon:
Desid. -मिमिक्षति, to wish to mix; to mingle,
unite one's self; [cf. सम्-मिक्ष् above.]
सम्-ईहा, f. striving after, longing for, desire.

सम्-ईहित, अस्, आ, अम्, longed or wished for,
desired; undertaken; (अम्), n. great effort to obtain
anything, desire, longing, wish.

सम्मिल् सम्-मिल्, cl. 6. P. A. -मिलति, -ते,
&c., to meet together, assemble together, be present,
associate with.

सम्मील् सम्-मील्, cl. 1. P. -मीलति, &c., to
close up (as a flower &c.); to shut the eyes: Caus.
-मीलयति, -यितुम्, to cause to close up, close, shut;
to close the eyes; to make insensible.

सम्-मिलित, अस्, आ, अम्, met together, assembled,
collected.

सम्-मिल्य, ind. having assembled or met toge-
ther.

सम्-मील्य, ind., Ved. having closed up, having
covered over, having enveloped.
सम्मिश्र् सम्-मिश्र्. See rt. मिश्र्.

सम्-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, commingled, mixed
together, mixed, mingled, blended, joined, con-
nected, furnished or endowed with.

सम्-मिश्रण, अम्, n. the act of commingling
or mixing together.

सम्-मिश्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed together, mingled,
intermixed with (with inst.).

सम्-मिश्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, = सम्-मिश्र above; (अस्),
m. ‘universal mingler,’ epithet of Indra.

सम्-मीलन, अम्, n. the closing up (of a flower
&c.), covering up, enveloping.

सामिधेन्य सामिधेन्य, अस्, m. (fr. सम्-इन्ध्
or सम्-इध्), a particular Mantra or mystical prayer.

सामिधेनी, f. a particular prayer or verse recited
whilst the sacrificial fire is being kindled or on add-
ing fuel to it (= धाय्या); fuel.
सामीची सामीची, f. praise, panegyric.

सामीप्य सामीप्य, अम्, n. (fr. समीप), near-
ness, vicinity, proximity, contiguity, nearness to the
[]
deity (as one of the four or five states or grades of
beatitude); (अस्), m. a neighbour.
